# Human MMP9 (P14780)
## UniProt Accession: P14780
## Full Name: Matrix metalloproteinase-9
## Organism: Homo sapiens (Human)
## Sequence:


## Manufacturer Information:
- **Enzo**: Produced in E. coli. Active recombinant matrix metalloproteinase-9 (MMP-9, gelatinase B, 92 kDa type IV collagenase) cloned from human cDNA. The enzyme consists of residues Phe107-Pro449 (NM_004994), which comprises the catalytic/fibronectin domain of human MMP-9, with a C-terminal purification tag. This represents a naturally-occurring active form of MMP-9 which lacks the C-terminal hemopexin domain. Activity toward its targets, such as gelatin, casein, or peptide substrates, is unaffected.
- **Sino Biological**: Human, HEK293 Cells, Met1-Asp707
